definition: Temperature of the ocean skin or foundation layer from satellite analysis or in situ
spatial/temporal res: 1-25 km daily typical; point buoys hourly
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat (thermal envelope); NEVER direct abundance
leakage/latency notes: NRT products revise; do not train with future analyses; intertidal emersion needs air T not SST

definition: In-situ or modelled temperature at depth (mixed layer, thermocline, bottom)
depth: 0-2000 m typical Argo; bottomT in models
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat; catchability for benthic species
leakage/latency notes: Delayed-mode Argo months later; models are not observations

definition: Practical salinity of near-surface seawater
spatial/temporal res: Argo points 10-day; SMAP ~40 km 8-day; models 9 km daily
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat (estuarine/plume); oyster stress co-factor
leakage/latency notes: SMAP land contamination; estuary needs in situ

definition: Sea surface height / absolute dynamic topography from altimetry or models
spatial/temporal res: L4 daily 0.125 deg; SWOT swath km-class
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy for circulation, fronts, eddies
leakage/latency notes: NRT vs REP; coastal altimetry poor

definition: Horizontal velocity of seawater
typical_sources: CMEMS-GLO-PHY; OSCAR-CURRENTS; NOAA-AOML-GDP; IOOS-CATALOG HF radar
spatial/temporal res: models 9 km 6-hourly; HF radar 1-6 km hourly; drifters Lagrangian
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy larval transport / forage aggregation; not abundance
leakage/latency notes: Do not invert currents as fish

definition: Depth of surface mixed layer
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat (light/nutrient/forage concentration)
leakage/latency notes: Definition (temp vs density) must be fixed for replay

definition: Mean height of the highest third of waves
role in species inference (direct/habita: operational catchability / farm gear stress; not biology count
leakage/latency notes: Not a navigation product

definition: Near-surface wind speed and direction
spatial/temporal res: 2.5 km NDFD hourly; ERA5 0.25 deg hourly
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy upwelling/waves; ops go/no-go
leakage/latency notes: ERA5 ~5-day delay vs GFS NRT — do not mix without cutoff

definition: Air temperature at standard height; critical for intertidal emersion heat
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct stressor for intertidal aquaculture when paired with tide
leakage/latency notes: Airport vs mudflat microclimate gap

definition: Observed or predicted water level relative to a datum
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct control of emersion; weak offshore
leakage/latency notes: Predictions omit surge unless OFS; datum required

definition: Seafloor depth relative to a specified vertical datum
spatial/temporal res: 15 arc-sec global; finer regional DTMs; static
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat structure; NEVER navigation
leakage/latency notes: Static; vertical datum mixing is a silent error

definition: Categorical seafloor habitat (EUNIS/CMECS/coral/seagrass/kelp)
spatial/temporal res: 5 m reefs to km predictive maps; map epoch
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat; not fish counts
leakage/latency notes: Licence landmines on UNEP-WCMC and WDPA; empty != absent

definition: Near-surface chlorophyll-a from ocean colour or BGC models
spatial/temporal res: 1-4 km daily with cloud gaps; 8-day composites
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy productivity/fronts; NEVER abundance or HAB toxin
leakage/latency notes: Clouds; Case-2 false highs; 8-day lag vs 24h decisions

definition: Diffuse attenuation coefficient at 490 nm (water clarity)
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat light/turbidity proxy
leakage/latency notes: Same cloud/Case-2 issues as chl

definition: Dissolved oxygen concentration
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat edge / stress; do not impute from SST
leakage/latency notes: No satellite DO; model coastal skill poor

definition: Dissolved inorganic nitrate
spatial/temporal res: climatology 1 deg monthly; BGC-Argo sparse; models daily
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy productivity; indirect
leakage/latency notes: Not 24h CPUE

definition: Dissolved inorganic phosphate
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy
leakage/latency notes: Sparse NRT

definition: Dissolved inorganic silicate
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy diatom production
leakage/latency notes: Climate scale

definition: Seawater pH on total scale
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat for calcifiers; weak 72h adult mortality
leakage/latency notes: Scale (total vs NBS) must be explicit

definition: Aragonite saturation state
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat larval shellfish
leakage/latency notes: Not NSSP; not adult 72h headline

definition: Partial pressure of CO2 in surface seawater
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy OA / air-sea flux not animals
leakage/latency notes: SOCAT annual delay

definition: Modelled or satellite-derived net primary production
typical_sources: CMEMS-GLO-BGC; NASA NPP algorithms; ESA CCI
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy forage production; lag to fish
leakage/latency notes: Algorithm family must be version-pinned

definition: Measured or indexed zooplankton biomass/abundance
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct prey for some species; lagged recruitment for others
leakage/latency notes: Not NRT; method mixing

definition: Hobday-style MHW category/duration/intensity from SST climatology
role in species inference (direct/habita: stressor/habitat compression; DHW for coral
leakage/latency notes: Baseline climatology is a modelling choice; surface != bottom MHW

definition: Freshwater streamflow to coastal ocean
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy salinity/turbidity/plume; oyster flood stress
leakage/latency notes: Provisional USGS revises; lag to estuary

definition: Fraction of ocean area covered by ice
typical_sources: CMEMS-SATELLITE-OC-SST; NOAA-OISST ice; NSIDC via NASA Earthdata
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat mask polar species / access
leakage/latency notes: Polar night sensors differ

definition: Optical turbidity / particle backscatter
typical_sources: IOOS-CATALOG; NASA-EARTHDATA-OCEAN bbp; NERRS via IOOS
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat feeding interference; plume tracer
leakage/latency notes: Biofouling sondes

definition: Spatiotemporal record of a taxon (presence, sometimes count)
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct presence prior; not local abundance nowcast
leakage/latency notes: Must filter CC BY-NC; coarsen sensitive taxa; sampling bias

definition: Fishery-independent catch-per-unit-effort or biomass index from designed surveys
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct relative abundance index at survey scale; not 24h
leakage/latency notes: Months delay; gear changes; do not treat as next-trip CPUE

definition: Assessed biomass and fishing mortality relative to reference points
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct population-scale prior; wrong timescale for trip products
leakage/latency notes: Years lag; assessed-stock bias

definition: Administrative landings or reconstructed catch
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy pressure; NOT CPUE or abundance without effort
leakage/latency notes: Confidential microdata; FAO commercial-promotion clause; SAU NC

definition: Telemetry locations or acoustic detections of tagged animals
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct individual movement; not population abundance
leakage/latency notes: Embargoes; CC mix; never publish precise protected-species paths

definition: Nautical area scattering coefficient from fisheries sonar
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy biomass if species-allocated; else unidentified scatterers
leakage/latency notes: Without trawl ID this is not species

definition: Detection of biological sounds (calls) in hydrophone archives
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct presence of sound-producing taxa; effort-correct for density
leakage/latency notes: Marine mammal locations NEVER_PUBLISH fine-scale

definition: Molecular detection of taxon DNA in environmental samples
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct presence of DNA; not live abundance or biomass
leakage/latency notes: Primer bias; transport of DNA; ABS/Nagoya; licence per study

definition: Human or ML identification of organisms in underwater images
unit: counts per frame or cover fraction
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct local counts if effort known; FathomNet policy says not occurrence dataset
leakage/latency notes: Filter NC licences; lights attract; not standardized CPUE unless survey design

definition: AIS/VMS-derived vessel presence or apparent fishing hours
role in species inference (direct/habita: WRONG TARGET if used as abundance; optional later effort confounder only
leakage/latency notes: GFW CC BY-NC; VMS restricted; identity NEVER_PUBLISH

definition: Whether a cell intersects a marine protected or managed area
role in species inference (direct/habita: constraint/mask; not habitat quality
leakage/latency notes: WDPA commercial ban; paper parks

definition: Nomenclatural accepted name and stable taxon ID
role in species inference (direct/habita: join key; not a prediction
leakage/latency notes: Do not redistribute full WoRMS DB; names change (Magallana)

definition: Global extinction-risk category for a taxon
role in species inference (direct/habita: sensitivity flag / coarsen rule; not local density
leakage/latency notes: Commercial via IBAT; do not publish CR location maps

definition: National farmed production statistics
role in species inference (direct/habita: context for farmed vs wild mix in occurrence DBs; not farm mortality
leakage/latency notes: FAO extra terms; not lease-level

definition: Official shellfish growing-area classification / closure under NSSP
role in species inference (direct/habita: WRONG TARGET for animal stress; legal harvest mask only as attributed official status
leakage/latency notes: FishAI must never authorize harvest

definition: Wind-driven coastal divergence index (e.g. Bakun)
spatial/temporal res: coastal stations daily; not a grid of fish
role in species inference (direct/habita: proxy ecosystem state
leakage/latency notes: Classic salmon-ocean covariate at seasonal not 48h bite

definition: Temperature at or near the seafloor
typical_sources: CMEMS-GLO-PHY bottomT; WOA23; IOOS gliders; cooperative trap sensors (regional)
spatial/temporal res: model 9 km 6-hourly; climatology; sparse in situ
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat/catchability for demersal/benthic; SST is a poor substitute when stratified
leakage/latency notes: Cooperative trap positions may be fishing-location sensitive

definition: Downwelling PAR at ocean surface or in water
role in species inference (direct/habita: habitat primary production / visual predators
leakage/latency notes: Clouds

definition: Reported harmful algal bloom event or cell/toxin measurement
unit: event or cells L-1 or toxin ug
typical_sources: HAEDAT; national HAB bulletins; ISSC-NSSP (legal not cells)
spatial/temporal res: events coarse; monitoring weekly in some regions
role in species inference (direct/habita: direct stressor/toxin context; NSSP is legal not physiology
leakage/latency notes: Do not substitute model chl for named HAB taxa or closures
